title: Architecture Recommendation
description: An ARCH-NNN structural recommendation, distinct from a SEC-NNN vulnerability finding (see finding.schema.json). Produced in 13_security_architecture_recommendations. Never applied automatically -- text-only guidance, same as remediation.schema.json.

priority.description: Critical architectural risk / High-value structural improvement / Recommended evolution / Optional optimization. A distinct scale from finding.schema.json's P0-P4 -- never conflated with it.

assessed_problem.description: The specific problem from 12_architecture_assessment this recommendation addresses, with evidence (file references).

rationale.description: Why, tied to assessed_problem and software-context.schema.json -- never a generic best-practice citation alone.

security_implications.description: How this specifically affects security posture (e.g. centralizing authorization, bounding a trust boundary).

phased_path.description: Ordered migration steps. A recommendation with only one step ('migrate to X') is a red flag for an unjustified big-bang change unless the change is genuinely that small.

related_findings.description: SEC-NNN finding IDs whose root cause this recommendation would address -- informational cross-reference only. The recommendation is not a substitute for those findings' own remediation.
